name: Dogmeat, Ever Loyal
oracle_text:
When Dogmeat enters, mill five cards, then return an Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to your hand.
Whenever a creature you control that's enchanted or equipped attacks, create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature you control that's enchanted or equipped attacks, create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

needs.what: an `equipped` key in the trigger filter language (TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS), so an `attacks` trigger can match "a creature you control that's enchanted or equipped" as `any_of: [{enchanted_by: true}, {equipped: true}]` -- true when any Equipment is attached to the attacking creature, whoever controls it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `enchanted_by` (covers the Aura half) and `attached` (only the one permanent the trigger's source is attached to, i.e. 'equipped creature' on an Equipment), but no 'is equipped by any Equipment' key; `equipped` and `modified` exist only in the effect selector language, not in trigger filters, so dropping the equipped branch or using `attached` would approximate the card
